scope: Independent algebra and primary-literature review only. No additional experiment, execution-source edit, model selection or performance measurement.

lambert_w.decision: Correct under the stated frozen-segment domain; suitable as an explanatory special-function expression.
domain: alpha>0, rho>0, sigma>0; all parameters finite; s=alpha/rho>0.
Fixed absolute reset a and independent refractory law D, with eta=E[exp(-rho*D)] in (0,1). For R>=1 Erlang phases of mean d>0: eta=((R/d)/(R/d+rho))^R.
a, s, k, i, eta and K are fixed with respect to the current unknown b. The reference model has K>0; the algebra uses s>0, k>0 and 0<eta<1.
The required continuation boundary satisfies b<a. Existence in that half-line requires R(a)>0.

definitions.q_scalar: q=k*a+k*C/s; this scalar is unrelated to the signed-content population also denoted q elsewhere.

derivation: Multiplying R(b)=0 by k/s gives z=eta*exp(z-q).
branch_and_existence_proof: R(a)=(s/k)*(q-eta), hence R(a)>0 is equivalent to q>eta.
With 0<eta<1 and q>eta: 0<eta*exp(-q)<eta*exp(-eta)<1/e. The Lambert argument is strictly in (-1/e,0), so exactly two real branches exist.
For W_0, z=-W_0(-eta*exp(-q)) lies in (0,1). Since z*exp(-z) is strictly increasing on (0,1), comparison with eta*exp(-eta) gives 0<z<eta<q. Consequently b<a.
For W_{-1}, z>1>eta. The defining equation gives z-q=log(z/eta)>0, hence b>a. This real branch is inadmissible for the required reset geometry.
For b<a, R_b=s*(1-eta*exp(k*(b-a)))>0 and R(b) tends to -infinity as b tends to -infinity. Thus R(a)>0 is necessary and sufficient for exactly one root with b<a.
If R(a)=0, the principal branch gives b=a, outside the strict domain. If R(a)<0, no root exists with b<a; real roots outside this domain, if present, do not supply an admissible policy.
implementation_boundary: A unique half-line root does not guarantee membership in the executable solver's finite bracket or in its finite-grid reset-deposition range. Retain the actual bracket, residual, root-domain and reset-projection checks.

The expression solves the frozen reference regenerative affine QVI. It is not the original financial paper's model, an exact optimal policy for the truncated reflecting finite chain, or a global closed form for the input-driven network.
This special-function expression does not establish a globally smooth numerical network or a stable floating-point Lambert evaluator.

The reported experiments used the qualified safeguarded Newton implementation and its implicit backward. Lambert W was not implemented or benchmarked, and no performance advantage is claimed for this expression.

prior_art.title: A Population Density Approach That Facilitates Large-Scale Modeling of Neural Networks: Analysis and an Application to Orientation Tuning

exact_locations.finding: Conservation-law population-density evolution; r(t)=J(v_th,t); a delta probability source at v_reset carrying the threshold flux; a delayed source for refractory time.

For the specified stationary setting, firing is a renewal process. Starting from reset and removing neurons after they fire makes threshold flux the first-spike/interspike-interval probability density.

prior_art.title: Dynamics of Sparsely Connected Networks of Excitatory and Inhibitory Spiking Neurons

exact_locations.finding: Fokker-Planck population density in (6), continuity and probability current in (7)-(8). Text before (9) states absorbing P(theta,t)=0 and firing rate nu(t)=S(theta,t); (9) specifies the threshold derivative. Equation (10) gives refractory-delayed reset reinjection through a current jump; (12) normalizes active probability plus refractory probability to one.

relevance_and_novelty_limits: Population-density evolution, threshold flux, absorption, reset/refractory reinjection and first-passage/renewal descriptions of neuronal firing are established prior methods, not foundational inventions of this project. These two primary papers demonstrate prior existence; this review does not identify the earliest origin.

The project's potential distinction should be framed as the specific reference-QVI endogenous policy, signed-content communication interface, differentiable implementation and finite weight-program combination, with its measured capabilities and limitations. This review does not establish that the entire combination is unprecedented, nor make an exhaustive novelty or patent conclusion.

Signed probability current in Nykamp-Tranchina denotes direction of motion through voltage space. The project's signed-content population is a mark carried by nonnegative probability mass; shared use of the word signed does not establish mathematical identity.
